name: Reschedule Flow — User Changes Appointment Date and Location
goal: User chooses to reschedule, changes both appointment date and location; bot executes correct workflows.
constraints: Eligibility mode is 'manage'; user selects 'Reschedule the appointment', changes both date and location.

result.message: You already have an appointment booked.

phases.description: Bot presents manage options; user selects 'Reschedule the appointment'.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot stores user intent as reschedule.

phases.description: Bot asks for new appointment date; user provides valid date.
Bot validates new date via workflow; receives valid response.
Bot asks if user wants to change location; user says Yes.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot calls update appointment date workflow, proceeds to state selection.

phases.description: User provides new state, city, and selects clinic.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot confirms new clinic selection and reschedules appointment.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
